# ADR-3080: A07: Concurrent session unlimited policy for account 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unlimited sessions hide account takeover.

## Decision

Accounts MUST NOT use a concurrent session unlimited policy for account 8 (A07-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Session inventories support remote revoke.
